title: A Safer Route
question: 把今天“好心活动 -> 路线不合适 -> 本该提前规划 -> 换到安全路线”的表达，放进 school holiday delivery 场景：用 word bank 补完整 5 个空。
example_answer: We wanted to take presents to the children's ward. We should have chosen a side route because the main hall was too busy. The huge mascot was holding up the traffic near the door. We ought to have asked first. It was fortunate that nobody was hurt, and we will use the side door next time.

options.label: A
options.scenario_zh: 先说明你们的好心目的
